race_story.note: Pick changes are changes in expected final points, not an additive explanation of championship probability. Results, ratings, and model updates can all contribute.

games_to_watch.rooting_note: South Carolina is favored to beat Clemson.

routes.headline: Root against Clemson.
routes.story: Holly gets a better shot if Clemson loses its next game.
routes.why: Holly picked Clemson to fall short of its preseason win target. Losses are good news for that pick.
routes.likelihood_text: This stretch comes through in about 61 out of 100 simulated seasons.
routes.narrative: The awkward part: Holly benefits when Clemson has a bad Saturday. A close escape still counts as a win, so ugly football alone will not do the job.
routes.banter: Holly lives surrounded by Alabama and Auburn fans without converting. Whatever Clemson does, nobody should mistake a temporary rooting interest for a change of allegiance.
routes.if_it_happens: If this stretch lands, Holly has a stronger title case and a ready-made reason to remind everyone about this pick.

title_routes.method: Possible routes, not a checklist that guarantees a title. Other games still matter. Scenarios use the next four games (or fewer if the season is ending), shared game results, fixed ratings, and equal shares for tied titles.

schedule_watch.summary: Changes in opponent strength are reshaping the road ahead.
schedule_watch.method: Same remaining opponents and venues, picked team held at its draft SP+ rating. Only opponent ratings change. Unrated opponents are excluded; coverage is shown. This measures schedule change, not total team improvement.
